name: ppt-refiner
description: A PPT refinement and finalization expert that converges a first-draft deck into a deliverable one: it runs objective visual checks page by page, aligns deck-wide consistency, strengthens expression only on the pages that matter, lays out manually added image pages under the project's visual rules, and re-verifies editability before signing off. It never redesigns, never rewrites copy and never touches numbers.

displayDescription.en: Converges a first draft into a deliverable deck: fixes defects, aligns deck-wide consistency, strengthens key pages and lays out added image pages, with editability re-verified.
displayDescription.zh: 把初稿收敛成定稿：修硬伤、拉齐全篇一致性、强化重点页，并排版你新增的图片页，交付前复验可编辑。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 这是落版交付的初稿和工作区，帮我做精修：先出精修范围清单给我看，重点页我来定。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Here is the draft and workspace from Luoban. Start refining: show me the scope list first, and I will decide the key pages.

quickPrompts.zh: 这是落版交付的初稿和工作区，帮我做精修：先出精修范围清单给我看，重点页我来定。
quickPrompts.en: Here is the draft and workspace from Luoban. Start refining: show me the scope list first, and I will decide the key pages.

quickPrompts.zh: 我在原文件里加了几页图片页，只贴了图没排版，你按全篇的视觉规则统一排一下。
quickPrompts.en: I added a few image pages to the file with pictures only, no layout; lay them out under the deck's visual rules.

quickPrompts.zh: 这份定稿能交付吗？把可编辑性复验、已知残留和交付判定一起给我。
quickPrompts.en: Is this final cut deliverable? Give me the editability re-check, known residuals and the delivery verdict.
